user.title: MeteoSwiss Radar
user.description:
Adds the MeteoSwiss radar proxy and the `meteoswiss-radar-card` Lovelace card. Local rain-nowcast entities are optional and off by default — enable them under Configure after setup.

Afterwards, reload the browser tab (in the Companion app: reset the frontend cache) — otherwise dashboards report "Custom element doesn't exist: meteoswiss-radar-card".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

data_description.nowcast_enabled: Evaluates the radar at the Home Assistant location and adds rain-nowcast sensors plus a rain-protection binary sensor for automations. Polls MeteoSwiss every 5 minutes while enabled; leave it off if you only want the card.
data_description.protection_min_hold_minutes: Once rain protection switches on it stays on for at least this long, even if the radar clears earlier. Prevents a passing shower from cycling whatever the signal drives — typically an awning motor. 0 disables the hold.
